code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (O2 saturation, pO2, and pH markedly low), anemia with erythrocytosis, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated ferritin, CRP, LDH, and INR, and mild renal impairment (creatinine high). These findings suggest severe systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or hypoxic injury, and multi-organ dysfunction. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are strongly recommended.
